_doc: The five domains of the dungeon (Dungeon Alive, Brandon 2026-11-12): one per gate boss, each with its own look ('theme': the folder under assets/tiles/env/themes/ whose pictures replace the base tiles; missing pictures fall back to the base set), its own dressing (src/decor.py) and, from slice 3, its own hazards and kin. 'arrival' is said the first time in a run the hero sets foot in the domain. 'decor' gives each layer of fixtures (data/fixtures.json): 'ids' with weights, 'room_chance' (the share of ordinary rooms that get any), 'per_room' [min, max], and for floor decals 'corridor_chance' per corridor tile. Slice 3 adds: 'kin' (a weight on each family's place in the spawn pool: lore, never the floor number, and every kind is still eligible only from its own depth), 'traps' (weights on the hidden trap kinds, 1 if not named), 'hazards' (domain hazards set by src/hazards.py: data/hazards.json) and the floor's resident clan ('clans', with 'clan_lines' per family). Floor layer: 'room_chance' of the rooms get one thing: either flat marks lying in the open ('per_room' of them), or one small group of objects against a wall ('cluster' [min, max], a corner first): rubble where a corner came down, bones in a nook. Corridors get flat marks only (Brandon's play-test, 2026-11-12).

domains.name: The Labyrinth
domains.arrival: It was the men of Minos who cut this stone, long ago. Somewhere below you a bull-headed thing walks his halls, and there is not one of them that he does not know.

domains.name: The Forgotten Temple
domains.arrival: Now the masonry changes to pale marble that is green in every crack, and ivy grows where no sun has ever reached. This was once a temple of Athena, until something made the goddess turn her face away from it, and its statues all look back over their shoulders.

domains.name: The Scorched Deep
domains.arrival: Here the worked stone ends and the raw caves begin, black with old soot, and the air tastes of ash. The bones that lie here once wore armour, and you see that the armour has melted.

domains.name: The Rime Halls
domains.arrival: Frost lies like fur upon the stones and creaks beneath your feet, and your breath hangs before you. Round shields hang on these walls, as in the halls of the north, and somewhere below, something has waited a long age for the end of the world.

domains.name: The Abyss
domains.arrival: The floor is of black glass and warm to the foot. Red light moves in the cracks, and smoke rises from below as from a great furnace, for you have come into the shaft of the Abyss, and at the bottom of it its king is waiting.

clans._doc: Most floors are held by one family: its kinds weigh 'mult' times more in the spawn pool. It is chosen from the families with at least 'min_kinds' kinds eligible on the floor, the domain's kin first. 'chance' is the share of ordinary floors with a clan.

clan_lines.demons: Sulphur hangs in the air, and claws have gouged the doors.
clan_lines.restless_dead: There is grave-dirt on the flagstones, and footprints lead away from it.
clan_lines.ghosts: The cold moves about here, though there is no draught to move it.
clan_lines.mortals: Here are boot-prints, cold fires and a dropped knife.
clan_lines.goblinkin: Crude marks are daubed on every wall.
clan_lines.giants: The doorways here have been knocked wider.
clan_lines.aberrations: Nothing here has the shape that a living thing should have.
clan_lines.fair_folk: Faint music comes from no direction at all.
clan_lines.vampires_liches: No rat or fly stirs, and no sound is heard.
clan_lines.dragons: The stone is scorched and smells of hot metal.
clan_lines.great_beasts: Claws have gouged the walls high overhead.
clan_lines.constructs: Gears and stone dust lie about, and something wound up long ago still ticks.
clan_lines.elementals: The air itself is restless here.
clan_lines.plants: Roots come through the walls and spores are on the air.
clan_lines.birds: There are feathers, and droppings on every ledge.
clan_lines.gorgons: Too many statues stand here, and every face is afraid.
clan_lines.shapeshifters: The footprints change shape halfway down a corridor.
